reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000133 (the melody read from 000133a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Arthur Seymour Sullivan's dates (1842–1900) are from our page for the tune ST. EDMUND (SULLIVAN) (content/hymns/tunes/st-edmund-sullivan.json); CCEH's page gives only the year 1874. The page gives no year for the tune itself; it was in print by 1874, the year of the arrangement. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000133a.nwc).
